tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send one test email through SendSoon. Pass the recipient in the to parameter. Without SENDSOON_API_KEY, one public IP can send up to 3 free test emails per day; after that, register on SendSoon, generate an API Key, and configure SENDSOON_API_KEY. Set content_type to text/html for HTML body.

body.description: Email body (plain text or HTML; max 512,000 UTF-8 bytes)

content_type.description: MIME content type for body (default: text/plain)

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key that prevents duplicate delivery when callers retry

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: Look up geolocation and ISP info for a public IPv4 or IPv6 address via SendSoon

ip.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up

tools.name: markitdown_convert
tools.description: Convert a local document to Markdown via SendSoon. Supported: pdf, docx, pptx, xlsx, xls, txt, md, html, htm. Images (png, jpg, etc.) and direct URLs are not supported. Provide file_path; the file name is detected automatically (max 10 MB).

file_path.description: Local path to the file to convert. The file name is detected automatically.
